snippet.title: No Man's Sky COSMOS Update Trailer
snippet.description:
COSMOS: INTRODUCING UPDATE 7.0

Claim and personalise a space station, join an alliance, construct a space base and discover deep-space marvels in No Man's Sky Cosmos.

Space exploration has been reinvented, with a new Star System Map to track the locations of points of interest. 

Strip colossal hulks for parts before hull integrity fails, recover and haul physical salvage to remote space outposts, or build a home out among the stars. 

Take command of a space station, and create or join an alliance to compete for the most expansive territory in the galaxy.  

Journey back through time in the Our Journey Continues expedition, celebrating 10 years of No Man's Sky. 

Full patch notes here: https://www.nomanssky.com/cosmos-update

ALWAYS LALISA
In Cinemas & IMAX Worldwide, October 12
Ticket at https://alwayslalisa.com

Always Lalisa is a feature-length documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from Blackpink, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. As the group pauses activities, LISA embarks on the first true chapter of her solo career, confronting the question of who she is beyond Blackpink.

The film follows LISA as she writes, records, and releases her debut solo album, Alter Ego, makes her acting debut in the third season of The White Lotus, and prepares for her first major solo performance at the 2025 Coachella Music Festival. Born and raised in Thailand, LISA left home at fourteen to train in South Korea's demanding K-pop system, ultimately rising to global superstardom. But forging her own path, particularly in the Western music market, brings new pressures, relentless scrutiny, and the challenge of redefining herself on her own terms.

Intimate, emotional, and revealing, Always Lalisa captures an artist at a crossroads, documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define not only her next chapter, but the woman and artist she wants to become.

VFX, Written, and Directed by Takashi Yamazaki
In theatres November 6
Follow @godzilla_toho and @GKIDSfilms for more updates!
godzillaminuszero.com

War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.
 
There is no third time. Everything ends here.

Shot entirely in Japan as the first-ever Japanese production to be Filmed For IMAX, GODZILLA MINUS ZERO was shot with high-definition digital cameras certified by IMAX, and optimized in sound and imagery unique to IMAX screens. The globally beloved monster returns to movie theater screens reaching greater and more terrifying heights, making GODZILLA MINUS ZERO a true cinematic event not to be missed.
